question:
The probability distribution of a random variable X is given by :
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline X & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \hline P(X) & p & \frac{p}{3} & \frac{p}{6} & \frac{p}{12} \\ \hline \end{array}$$
(i) Determine the value of p. (ii) Calculate $P(X\ge1)$. (iii) Calculate expectation of X, i.e. E(X).
explanation:
**Step 1:** According to probability distribution axioms, the sum of all individual structural probabilities must equal exactly 1. We set up the sum equation: $p + \frac{p}{3} + \frac{p}{6} + \frac{p}{12} = 1$. Multiplying by 12 gives $12p + 4p + 2p + p = 12 \implies 19p = 12 \implies p = \frac{12}{19}$.
**Step 2:** For part (ii), use the complement rule to calculate the probability: $P(X \ge 1) = 1 - P(X = 0) = 1 - p = 1 - \frac{12}{19} = \frac{7}{19}$.
**Step 3:** For part (iii), use the mean expectation formula $E(X) = \sum x_i P(X=x_i) = 0(p) + 1(\frac{p}{3}) + 2(\frac{p}{6}) + 3(\frac{p}{12}) = \frac{p}{3} + \frac{p}{3} + \frac{p}{4} = \frac{11p}{12}$. Substituting $p = \frac{12}{19}$ yields $E(X) = \frac{11}{19}$.
